title: Create: Sandpapers
description: Create: Sandpapers expands automation by adding new kinds of sandpaper and helpful recipes.
body:
# Create: Sandpapers

For **Minecraft 1.21.1** on **NeoForge** with **Create 6.0+**.

An addon for the Create mod that improves sandpaper and expands automation:

- **Crushed Iron Sandpaper** (128 durability), **Crushed Diamond Sandpaper** (256) and **Sturdy Obsidian Sandpaper** (512) — fully working Create sandpapers: polish items in your offhand or on the ground, or automate with a Deployer.
- **Block polishing** — right click stone, sandstone, deepslate, basalt, blackstone, quartz, granite, diorite, andesite and Create's cut stone types (plus their slab/stair/wall variants) with any sandpaper to polish them in place.
- **The Polishing Wheel** — a kinetic machine built like the Crushing Wheels that polishes items in bulk. Craft a pair with mechanical crafting and drop items between them.
- **Crushed Iron / Crushed Diamonds** — made in Crushing Wheels, used to craft the new sandpapers.
- **Sequenced assembly lines** for Rose Quartz (from quartz, water, lava and red dye), Unrefined Lapis Lazuli (polish it for extra lapis) and Ink Sacs (from paper, water and coal).
- Sandpapers show their durability when holding **Alt**, and scrubbing living things with one hurts. Don't.
